headline: Elisha Project lease, Piccadilly tax stabilization at 30 Beecher Street, and tax abatements of $22,312.67 and $152,458.08.
summary: Mayor Grebien has sent letters on Hasbro, Inc. CEO Chris Cocks's remarks and on School Department challenges. The agenda also lists a Pawtucket High School construction report and several RI Energy pole petitions.
items: Consent agenda: notice from RI Department of Environmental Management on Tidewater Landing River Walk
Consent agenda: resident request for a pedestrian signal light
Consent agenda: Pawtucket High School construction report
Consent agenda: mayor's letter on Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks's remarks and the future of 1027 Newport Avenue
Consent agenda: mayor's statement on Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks's comments
Consent agenda: mayor's letter to the School Committee on School Department challenges
Consent agenda: Public Works response on the Rice Street crosswalk
Consent agenda: RI Energy response on worsened problems on Smithfield Ave.
Consent agenda: response on 1 Moshassuck St.
Consent agenda: police response on illegal parking on Harris St.
Consent agenda: zoning response on an illegal auto repair facility
Consent agenda: mayor's letter on the Elisha Project lease, referred to the City Property and Ordinance committees
Consent agenda: Elisha Project lease request from George Ortiz, referred to the City Property and Ordinance committees
Consent agenda: Piccadilly LLC tax stabilization agreement for 30 Beecher Street, referred to the Finance Committee
Consent agenda: tax abatement recommendations and resolution for April, May, and June 2026, totaling $22,312.67, referred to the Finance Committee
Consent agenda: tax abatement recommendations and resolution for July, August, and September 2026, totaling $152,458.08, referred to the Finance Committee
Consent agenda: claim by Luzia Smith through Progressive Subrogation for $136.00 (firetruck), referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits
Consent agenda: claim by Lynn Farinelli for $100,000.00, referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust
Traffic issues on Roosevelt Avenue
RI Energy petition to install a pole at Lily Pond St., pending Public Works director approval
RI Energy petition to install a joint pole at Division Street, pending Public Works director approval
RI Energy petition to relocate multiple poles on Daggett Ave., pending Public Works director approval
RI Energy petition to install a joint pole at Broadway, pending Public Works director approval
RI Energy petition to install a joint pole at South Bend St., pending Public Works director approval
RI Energy petition to install a pole at Lily Pond St., pending Public Works director approval
Mayor's appointment of Michael William Cooper to the Juvenile Hearing Board, for council confirmation
Claims returned by the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Pericles Vieira, $1,349.08 (tire); Napoleon Gonsalves, $275.00 (pothole); Nicholas Jensen, $315.98 (pothole)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, City Council Chambers, 100 Freight Street
